title: Fix the Unused Generator
description: The program should print each even number produced by a generator function. Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
def even_numbers(limit):
    n = 0
    while n <= limit:
        yield n
        n += 2

result = even_numbers(6)
print(result)
expectedBehavior: The program should print 0, 2, 4, 6 — the even numbers produced by the generator.
actualProblem: Calling even_numbers(6) creates a generator object but doesn't run its code yet; printing result just shows something like '<generator object ...>' instead of the actual values, because the generator was never iterated over.
explanation: A generator function returns a generator object immediately, without running any of its code. Values are only produced as the generator is iterated (e.g. with a for loop or next()) — printing the generator itself just shows its object representation.
